question: India won the Thomas Cup in the year _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**2022.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Thomas Cup:-**

 
 
• ​It is a prestigious international** badminton tournament **held every **two years.**
 
• **India won its first-ever Thomas Cup title or Badminton World Men's Team Championship for the first time in 73 years on May 15, 2022, beating Indonesia 3-0 in the final in Bangkok.**
 
• In the edition of the Thomas Cup held in 2018, China emerged as the champions.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• No Thomas Cup as was held in 2019, and 2021 years due to the COVID-19 pandemic.
